summary.what_it_does: The page itself is a "page not found" error on products.office.com and contains no product description, features, or pricing. The only product text comes from the awesome-mac listing, which describes Microsoft Office as "Unmistakably Office, designed for Mac" and links to the Mac App Store. The page text lists Microsoft site navigation (Office, Windows, Surface, Xbox, Support) and no details about the software.
notable: Distributed via the Mac App Store according to the listing
caveats: The linked page is a 404 error and cannot be verified
No pricing or feature details are available on the page
